opportunities.title: Regular Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, Charitable Incorporated Organisations (CIOs), and exempt/excepted organisations under Charity Commission guidance; must have at least one year's worth of annual accounts (independently audited/examined or a Charity Commission annual return).
opportunities.summary: Grants under £100,000 for operating/core costs, capital projects, or projects/specific activities. Open to applications all year round with no deadlines for submission; decisions given within approximately 4-6 months.

opportunities.title: Major Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: For core costs, the organisation's annual income must be at least £1 million; for capital or project costs, the total cost of the project must be at least £1 million regardless of annual income. Applicant must be an eligible UK registered charity/CIO/exempt organisation.
opportunities.summary: Grants of £100,000 and over, considered by Trustees at one of eight Board meetings per year. Applicants submit a Major Grant Expression of Interest Form; Expressions of Interest are accepted all year round with no deadlines and reviewed on a rolling basis, with bespoke guidance given within 10 working days.
